column3: Description
column4: Acceptance Criteria

column3: App launch screen with logo animation and EN/AR language switch.
column4:
• Logo animation plays on launch
• Language toggle switches EN↔AR instantly
• Selected language persists across sessions
• RTL layout applies correctly when Arabic is selected
column8: Assume client will share the Logo and other branding details

column3: Screen for entering mobile number with country code picker.
column4:
• International format validated before submission
• Country code picker includes all GCC countries
• Invalid number shows inline error — no submission

column3: OTP delivered via Push Notification (FCM) with SMS as fallback.
column4:
• OTP delivered within 30 seconds
• 60-second resend timer enforced on screen
• Max 3 attempts before temporary lockout
• Correct OTP proceeds to sign-up or home screen

column3: Collects full name, optional email, date of birth.
column4:
• All required fields validated before submission
• Email validated as valid format if provided
• Form state preserved if user navigates back

column3: Google Places text search for office building selection.
column4:
• Search returns results within 2 seconds
• Building selection saved to user profile
• No map embed — text search only

column3: Captures floor number, desk number, and delivery instructions.
column4:
• All fields accept free text
• Delivery instructions optional, max 200 characters
• Details saved and displayed on home screen

column3: JWT token management and subscription state guard on all routes.
column4:
• JWT refresh happens silently before expiry
• Persistent login survives app restart
• Expired/invalid token redirects to OTP screen
• Subscription state (NEW/ACTIVE/PAUSED/EXPIRED) gates correct screens

column3: Home screen shown before any plan is purchased.
column4:
• Menu is visible in preview/locked state
• Choose Plan CTA is prominent
• Benefit highlights displayed
• Cannot access subscription screens without a plan

column3: Comparison cards for Trial, Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly plans.
column4:
• All plan tiers displayed with correct pricing
• Selected plan visually highlighted
• Proceeding to checkout only enabled with a selection

column3: Geolocation prompt + building search + desk details on first purchase.
column4:
• Geolocation permission prompt shown
• Building search pre-filled if location granted
• Address saved before checkout proceeds

column3: Prevents access to subscription features before plan purchase.
column4:
• Any attempt to access subscription screens redirects to plan selection
• Guard works after app restart

column3: Main screen for active subscribers — shows today's meal, plan status, quick actions.
column4:
• Today's meal card displayed with correct meal details
• Plan status bar shows days remaining and plan type
• Active delivery address shown
• Quick Skip button visible and functional
• Deep links to all major sections present

column3: Manage saved delivery addresses.
column4:
• All saved addresses listed
• Add, edit, delete, and set-default all function correctly
• Default address reflected on home screen

column2: Menu list — Mon to Fri tabbed
column3: Weekly meal menu with daily tabs.
column4:
• Each day tab shows correct meals
• Meal cards show name, photo, and calorie summary
• Switch eligibility badge shown where applicable

column3: Full nutritional breakdown per meal.
column4:
• Ingredients, macros, allergens, and calorie breakdown displayed
• Add Salad toggle functional if salad is available
• Photos load within 2 seconds

column3: Switch meal for entire plan or specific days.
column4:
• User can choose 'Entire Plan' or 'Specific Days'
• Day picker functional for specific-day mode
• Switch window enforced — unavailable past 6 PM for next day

column3: Plan overview — days remaining, skip count, delivery count, renewal.
column4:
• Days remaining calculated correctly
• Skip count shows remaining / total
• Renewal prompt banner appears when ≤ 5 days remain

column3: Skip next-day meal delivery with 6 PM cutoff enforcement.
column4:
• Calendar picker shows skippable days only
• 6 PM lock enforced — tomorrow unavailable after 6 PM
• Skip counter decrements immediately
• Undo available within allowed window

column3: Pause active subscription for a date range.
column4:
• Date range picker functional
• Maximum pause days rule enforced
• Confirmation screen shown before pause applied
• Subscription state changes to PAUSED correctly

column3: Edit personal details and notification preferences.
column4:
• Name and language preference editable and saved
• Push notification settings toggle functional
• Changes reflected immediately across app

column3: Unique referral code with share sheet and credit tracking.
column4:
• Unique referral code displayed per user
• Native share sheet triggered on share tap
• Credits earned displayed correctly
• Referral code validated on new user sign-up

column3: 1–5 star rating with optional photo and text.
column4:
• Star rating 1–5 selectable
• Photo upload optional — uploaded to S3
• Text note optional, max 500 characters
• Rating submitted and confirmed to user

column3: Paginated delivery history with calorie totals.
column4:
• History sorted by date, newest first
• Each entry shows meal name, date, calories
• Cumulative calorie chart renders correctly
• Pagination loads additional records correctly

column3: Home screen shown when subscription has expired.
column4:
• EXPIRED state detected and correct screen shown
• Renewal CTA prominent
• No active meal card shown

column3: Plan selection for renewal with upgrade highlights.
column4:
• Current plan highlighted
• Upgrade options shown with pricing difference
• Selecting a plan proceeds to checkout

column3: Order summary with promo code and wallet credit.
column4:
• Order summary shows correct plan and price
• Promo code entry validates and applies discount
• Wallet credit applies if available
• Total amount shown before payment

column3: Apple Pay, Google Pay, and card — Telr or Tap integration.
column4:
• Apple Pay available on iOS where supported
• Google Pay available on Android where supported
• Card form validates number, expiry, CVV
• Payment failure shows clear error message
• Payment success triggers subscription creation

column3: Confirmation screen with receipt summary.
column4:
• Lottie animation plays on success
• Receipt summary shows plan, amount, next delivery date
• User can navigate to home from this screen

column3: Invoice list with downloadable PDF receipts.
column4:
• All transactions listed with status
• PDF receipt downloadable per transaction
• Receipt PDF is correctly formatted

column3: Home screen shown when subscription is paused.
column4:
• PAUSED state detected and correct screen shown
• Days remaining in pause shown
• Resume CTA visible and functional

column3: Confirm resume with optional new start date.
column4:
• Resume confirmation shown before applying
• Optional new start date selectable
• Subscription transitions to ACTIVE on confirmation

column3: Hidden driver entry — role determined from OTP response.
column4:
• Driver role flag from API routes to driver home
• No separate driver app — same build
• Customer cannot access driver screens

column3: Sorted delivery list by building and floor.
column4:
• Deliveries grouped by building then floor
• Per-order status toggle visible
• List refreshes on pull-to-refresh

column3: Mark individual deliveries as delivered.
column4:
• Mark-delivered action updates status immediately
• Quick-call shortcut dials customer number
• Issue reporting accessible from detail screen

column3: Camera QR scan to confirm delivery.
column4:
• Camera opens on tap
• Valid QR confirms delivery
• Invalid QR shows error
• Confirmation feedback shown to driver

column3: All strings translated, RTL layout throughout.
column4:
• Every visible string has an Arabic translation
• RTL layout applied correctly in Arabic mode
• Arabic date and number formats used
• Language switch works from profile screen

column3: Delivery reminders, skip-window alerts, renewal nudges via FCM.
column4:
• Delivery reminder sent day-before or morning-of delivery
• Skip-window alert sent before 6 PM cutoff
• Renewal nudge sent ≤ 5 days before expiry
• Tapping notification deep-links to correct screen
• User can disable notifications from profile

column3: In-app credit display, referral earnings, usage history.
column4:
• Balance displayed correctly on checkout and profile
• Referral credits applied correctly
• Usage history shows credit/debit transactions
